tasks_list.description: List of tasks to document or reference in comment; each item must have 'name' and optionally 'description'. Not used by CLI, only for documentation/comments.

require_modules.description: List of module paths to pre-load with --require (e.g., ['ts-node/register', '@babel/register']).

custom_gulpfile.description: Path to explicit gulpfile. If set, CLI will use this file and set CWD to its directory.

custom_cwd.description: Manual working directory (CWD) for gulp execution; affects gulpfile search and relative requires.

color.description: If true, forces color output (--color); if false, forces no color (--no-color).

verify_plugins.description: If true, enables plugin blacklist verification (--verify).
